title: console-tooling-standup-2026-06-23
notes:
Date: 2026-06-23
Time: 09:30-10:00 PT
Location: Zoom / #console-rollouts

Agenda:
- Quick sync on UI feature parity for rollout routes
- Analytics instrumentation gaps for rollout experiments
- Deployment schedule for canary -> 50% -> global
- Blockers and action items

Updates:
- Maya: UI work on rollout details page nearly done. Remaining: mobile responsive tweaks and final accessibility (aria) fixes. Targeting PR by EOD Thurs. PR refs: GH PR 1245. Notes: some CSS regression on the filters bar when the user list is long — will add overflow behavior.

- Ethan: Backend route toggles and API for rollout gating merged to staging. Added endpoint to fetch rollout exposure metrics. Still need to add pagination to avoid large payloads for orgs with many routes. Follow-up JIRA: CONSOLE-901.

- Priya: Analytics tagging — discovered two missing events for the new rollout preview modal (preview_open, preview_accept). Implemented client-side events and sent draft schema to analytics (Confluence link). Need backend to include rollout_id in the modal payload for consistent attribution.

- Jordan: Instrumentation for latency/error rate on the canary model is live. Seeing a small spike in tokenization errors for a subset of requests (0.2% -> 0.8%). Investigating whether this is related to the new batching change. Working with SRE (Samir) to correlate logs.

- Lena: UX QA pass reported copy issues in the rollout summary and missing tooltip on quantization recommendation. Opened follow-up copy tickets and updated the a11y checklist.

Blockers:
- Mobile layout regression (Maya) — blocks polish before ship. Low severity but visible on demo. Estimated 1 day to fix if no other priorities.
- Missing rollout_id in modal payload (Priya) — backend change required, ticket CONSOLE-842. ETA 2 days, currently scheduled for next sprint if we don't unblock.
- Tokenization error spike (Jordan) — needs deeper infra tracing; SRE assistance requested. Samir to run correlation by EOD.

Decisions made:
- Proceed with canary rollout to 10% tomorrow morning as planned, but gate feature flag to auto-fallback if tokenization errors exceed 1% for 5 consecutive minutes. SRE to implement fallback watch.
- Ship UI changes to staging with feature flag enabled for internal QA only until mobile regression is fixed.

Action items / owners:
- Maya: Open PR for UI fixes and add overflow fix for filters bar (due 2026-06-24).
- Ethan: Implement pagination for rollout API responses and include rollout_id in modal payload (due 2026-06-25).
- Priya: Update analytics schema and coordinate with backend for rollout_id (due 2026-06-25).
- Jordan & Samir: Correlate tokenization errors with batching change and propose mitigation (investigation update due 2026-06-23 EOD).
- Lena: Complete UX QA pass and raise copy tickets + tooltip task (due 2026-06-24).
- All: Add any missing test cases to the rollout e2e suite.

Parking lot / notes to self:
- Consider adding an explicit "rollback window" metric in the console to show how recently a rollout changed (for quicker decision making).
- Follow up on long-term plan to batch rollout analytics to reduce ingestion spikes — link to Optimize team follow-up.

Meeting wrap:
- Next standup: 2026-06-30 09:30 PT
- Please add short status updates to the JIRA tickets rather than Slack when unblocking a ship decision.

Rough/brainstorm fragments (notes to self):
- Could we expose per-route cost delta in the rollout UI? low effort if we pull precomputed token cost table from billing export. Worth prototyping.
- If tokenization errors track with batch size distribution, add circuit-breaker to lower batch size for affected tenants.

References / Links mentioned:
- GH PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/1245
- JIRA: CONSOLE-842 (modal payload)
- JIRA: CONSOLE-901 (pagination for rollout API)
- Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/CONSOLE/pages/5482 (rollout experiment playbook)

Document quality: working notes — minimal copy edit. Share with product and SRE for awareness.
summary: Weekly standup for Console & Tooling. Main focuses: ship UI fixes, add rollout_id to modal payload, investigate tokenization error spike, and proceed with canary rollout to 10% with fallback watch.
